title: [08/07/2023] The process of making cheese
prompt: The diagram below shows the process of making cheese. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagram illustrates the manufacturing process of cheese.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: The process involves nine distinct stages, beginning with the draining of whey from curds and culminating in the production of ripened cheese.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Initially, whey is drained from curds in a large container. Following this, the curds are broken down through a milling process into smaller pieces. Salt is then sprinkled over the milled curds as they move along a conveyor belt. At this stage, some of the mixture is collected to produce fresh cheese (cottage and cream cheese). The remaining seasoned mixture is then poured into molds to give the cheese its initial shape.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: In the subsequent stages, the cheese-filled molds are compressed using a pressing mechanism, during which additional whey is extracted. The pressed cheese pieces are then transferred to special shelves where they are left to mature for a period of time. The end result of this process is fully ripened cheese, which appears as rounded blocks ready for consumption.
